Hi Jonas / Redwood AP team,

We received invoice IR-2026-07-Polaris-TopUp-invoice-001 (ref: DL-9821-PH) this morning. Two quick items before we process payment:

1) VAT line is blank on the PDF we received. Polaris is registered for VAT in the EU (VAT ID: EU123456789). For B2B transactions we usually process under reverse-charge when you issue to our VAT-registered entity — can you confirm whether this should be zero-rated with a reverse-charge note or if Redwood intends to charge VAT?

2) The invoice is for a mid-month capacity top-up (added 10 GPUs on 2026-07-10). We need a short line-item breakdown showing the pro-rated days, unit rate, and gross/net totals so our AP ledger can reconcile against the PO (PO# PH-2026-457).

We also need the billing contact name and the correct Redwood VAT/Tax registration number to include on our payment instructions.

Could you reissue a corrected invoice with the VAT treatment clearly stated and the PO# on it? Also confirm expected due date (we try to pay Net 30).

Thanks — Marta

- Include Net/Gross breakdown and a short capacity-change Excel summary.

Jonas / Marissa — quick tax guidance from our side:

- If Polaris provides a valid EU VAT registration number and the invoice is addressed to that VAT-registered entity, we should apply the reverse-charge mechanism (i.e., no VAT charged on the invoice, with a clear reverse-charge statement).
- If the billing entity is not VAT-registered or the VAT ID is missing/invalid, Redwood must charge VAT at the local rate (we're set up to apply the correct country rate based on billing address).

Marissa — please prepare a corrected invoice draft with: PO# PH-2026-457, the capacity pro-rate lines, and one of the two tax treatments depending on the confirmation from Marta. Also include our Redwood VAT/Tax reg: RW-EU-44590012 and Redwood billing contact in the signature block.

Jonas — please ask Marta to confirm the billing entity name exactly as it appears on their VAT certificate and resend the VAT ID if there is a different format.

Thanks — Lauren
